description: Removes one person's assignment to a module (id from read entity training_assignments), as Assign's Remove does (owner or admin seats only). Assigning training stays a person's (it creates a sign-in). A repeat after it is gone answers success. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: remove_training_assignment
title: Remove a training assignment
